name: bit-parallel pattern match
mechanism: keep the set of pattern positions currently matched as a bit vector and update it for each text character with shifts and masks precomputed per character, so a match is detected when a designated bit becomes set; approximate variants keep one vector per allowed error

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bitap algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Approximate sequence matching: fuzzy algorithm that determines if strings are approximately equal.

requires: pattern length within the machine word (or multi-word emulation)
fails_when: patterns longer than a word lose the constant factor
